# bruce

**B**ayesian **R**io **U**rban **C**limate **E**stimator, generalised to
any city.

`bruce` interpolates daily urban air temperature by fusing observation
networks of different quality — official stations, airports, low-cost
IoT sensors, citizen weather stations — with an optional gridded
background (e.g. ERA5-Land). It was developed for Rio de Janeiro’s heat
surveillance and is written so that any city with comparable data can
use it: everything city-specific enters through a small data contract.

## Model

For an observation of network *k* at station *i*, location *s*, day *t*:

η = β₀ + δₖ + x(s)ᵀβ + uᵢ + wₜ + ξ(s, t)

- **δₖ** — offset of a biased network (estimated only for networks
  declared `bias = TRUE`)
- **x(s)ᵀβ** — spatial covariates (elevation, urban fraction, …)
- **uᵢ** — iid station effect (persistent siting bias)
- **wₜ** — city-wide daily AR(1) term
- **ξ(s, t)** — Matérn SPDE field with AR(1) dependence between days

Each network (and the background) has its own Gaussian likelihood with a
fixed or PC-prior observation standard deviation. Windows (one month is
the tested scale) are fitted independently with R-INLA.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),
                 INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep = TRUE)
remotes::install_github("asgouveiaa/bruce")
```

## Data contract

| object | columns |
|----|----|
| `obs` | `station_id`, `date`, `value` (one value per station and day) |
| `stations` | `station_id`, `source`, and `x`/`y` (projected) or `lon`/`lat` |
| `sources` | `source`, `bias` (`FALSE` = reference), `obs_sd` (fixed, or `NA` to estimate) |
| `background` *(optional)* | `date`, `value`, `x`/`y` or `lon`/`lat` of cell centres |
| covariates | a [`terra::SpatRaster`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatRaster-class.html), one named layer per covariate |

At least one reference network is required.

## Workflow

``` r

library(bruce)
sim  <- bruce_simulate(seed = 1)          # or your own city's data

d    <- bruce_data(sim$obs, sim$stations, sim$sources, crs = sim$crs,
                   background = sim$background)
d    <- bruce_covariates(d, sim$covariates)
mesh <- bruce_mesh(d)
fit  <- bruce_fit(d, mesh, bruce_spec(), keep_config = TRUE)
bruce_check(fit)                          # every attempt, collapse diagnostics

pred <- bruce_predict(fit, n_samples = 200, keep_samples = TRUE)
expo <- bruce_zonal(pred, zones, id_col = "zone", weights = population)
cv   <- bruce_cv(d, mesh, scheme = "lso", checkpoint_dir = "cv_lso")
```

## Degenerate fits

With clustered networks the day-to-day correlation of the field can
drift to 1 and its variance explode.
[`bruce_fit()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_fit.md)
checks every fit and, by default, restarts the mode search from a reset
point and, if that also collapses, refits with the correlation fixed
(`fallback_group_rho`, default 0.55). All attempts are kept in
`fit$attempts`; `fit$status` records the outcome. See
[`?bruce_spec`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_spec.md)
(`on_collapse`).

## Status

Version 0.1: daily temperature, independent windows. Planned: sub-daily
resolution, humidity and heat index, bivariate fields.

The `analises/` folder of the repository has the Rio de Janeiro and
Berlin applications, mapping their inputs onto the contract.

# Package index

## Data

Declare what the city has: observations, stations, networks, background
and covariates.

- [`bruce_data()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_data.md)
  : Assemble and validate input data
- [`bruce_covariates()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_covariates.md)
  : Attach spatial covariates

## Model

- [`bruce_mesh()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_mesh.md)
  : Build the SPDE mesh
- [`bruce_spec()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_spec.md)
  : Model specification
- [`bruce_fit()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_fit.md)
  : Fit the model for one time window
- [`bruce_check()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_check.md)
  : Diagnostics of a fit

## Use the fit

- [`bruce_grid()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_grid.md)
  : Prediction grid at a chosen resolution
- [`bruce_predict()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_predict.md)
  : Predict on a raster grid
- [`bruce_decompose()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_decompose.md)
  : Decompose the predicted surface into its components
- [`plot(`*`<bruce_decomposition>`*`)`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/plot.bruce_decomposition.md)
  : Plot a decomposition
- [`bruce_zonal()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_zonal.md)
  : Aggregate predictions over zones
- [`as_tibble(`*`<bruce_prediction>`*`)`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/as_tibble.bruce.md)
  [`as_tibble(`*`<bruce_decomposition>`*`)`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/as_tibble.bruce.md)
  : Prediction or decomposition as a long table

## Validation

- [`bruce_cv()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_cv.md)
  : Cross-validation by station or by region
- [`bruce_simulate()`](https://asgouveiaa.github.io/bruce/reference/bruce_simulate.md)
  : Simulate a synthetic city
